notes.title: The Drunken Beard - August Demo Update!
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597373/3686c38597a0e0ed7594ea4511fcfc095414f206.png"]Our work to continuously improve the game never stops. This update introduces new features such as the ability to create food in addition to brewing beer. Quality of life improvements and important fixes have been made to make your tavern management experience even smoother and more enjoyable!



### ✨ Features ✨

Added food-based recipes

Added multi ingredients processing (chop, chop and cook, and so on)

Added daily menu to choose which recipes to sell to customers



### 🛠️ Quality of Life (QoL) Changes 🛠️

Massive improvement in player movement and how it select things inside tavern

Massive HUD restyling

Avoid opening megamenu when daily menu is open

QoL changes and minor fixes



### 🐛 Fixes 🐛

Fixed the order tile ingredients

Fixed the orders list

Restored moral after eating

Fixed then active recipes grid in daily menu

Changed the game menu button style

Fixed the player lighting

Fixed the sink lighting

Stop analogue clock when game paused

Fixed the quest log

Fixed the widget focus when using gamepad

Fixed the customer payment

Fixed the notification quantity

Fixed the UI navigation when using gamepad

Fixed the customer bugs

Fixed the player's shadow outside tavern

Added dirty vfx on mug and bowl



We're incredibly grateful for everyone who has played the demo so far and provided valuable feedback. 

Keep it coming!  Now, get back to brewing and building the most renowned tavern in the land!  

*The Drunken Beard Development Team*

notes.title: The Drunken Beard - Demo Update!
notes.notes:
We've been hard at work polishing The Drunken Beard demo based on your feedback and our own brewing experiments. This update brings some exciting new features, much-requested quality-of-life improvements, and important fixes to make your tavern management experience even smoother and more fun!

---

### ✨ Features ✨

* **Revamped Build Mode:** We've overhauled the tavern construction system! Building your dream dwarven establishment is now more intuitive and offers greater flexibility. Get creative and expand your legendary pub!
* **Improved Tutorial:** For all our new innkeepers, we've polished the tutorial to better guide you through the initial steps of tavern management, from pouring your first ale to serving your first hungry customer.

---

### 🛠️ Quality of Life (QoL) Changes 🛠️

* **Customers HUD:** Keep better track of your patrons' needs! We've updated the customer Heads-Up Display for clearer information on their orders and satisfaction.
* **Camera Rotation Speed Adjusted:** We've tweaked the camera rotation speed for a more comfortable viewing experience as you manage your bustling tavern.
* **UI Enhancements:** Various elements of the user interface have been improved for better clarity and ease of use.
* **Improved Player Interaction:** Interacting with objects and stations in your tavern should now feel more responsive and intuitive.

---

### 🐛 Fixes 🐛

* **Removed Free Camera:** The free camera mode has been removed for this demo version to ensure a more focused gameplay experience.
* **Performance Improvements:** We've made several optimizations under the hood to improve overall game performance and reduce stutters.

---

We're incredibly grateful for everyone who has played the demo so far and provided valuable feedback. Keep it coming!

Now, get back to brewing and building the most renowned tavern in the land!

*The Drunken Beard Development Team*
